feeds.title: Global Fund for Women News
feeds.description: Global Fund for Women is one of the world's leading foundations for gender equality, standing up for the human rights of women and girls. It campaigns for zero violence, economic and political empowerment, and sexual and reproductive health and rights.

feeds.title: California Women's Law Center Blog
feeds.description: CWLC breaks down barriers & advances the potential of women & girls through transformative litigation, policy advocacy and education.

feeds.title: National Organization for Women
feeds.description: Say It, Sister! is a place where NOW leaders speak their minds, discuss feminist issues and call women to action. NOW's purpose is to promote feminist ideals, lead societal change, eliminate discrimination, and achieve and protect the equal rights of all women and girls in all aspects of social, political, and economic life.

feeds.title: Martha y Maria: Women's Lives, Women's Rights
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to Martha, Maria and all women who courageously negotiate their lives in this world filled with gang warfare and international warfare, poverty and wealth, drug trafficking and addiction, and lack of access to birth control, legal abortion, and other health care.

feeds.title: Equal Rights Advocates
feeds.description: Equal Rights Advocates is a nonprofit legal organization dedicated to protecting and expanding economic and educational access and opportunities for women and girls. Equal Rights Advocates has transformed the law for hundreds of thousands of women and girls for over four decades through impact litigation, advice and counseling, and policy reform.

feeds.title: National Women's Political Caucus Blog
feeds.description: The NWPC is a multi-partisan grassroots organization dedicated to increasing women's participation in the political process and creating a political power base designed to achieve equality for all women.

feeds.title: FEMINIST GIANT
feeds.description: Feminist Giant is a bold, global feminist blog and newsletter created by Mona Eltahawy that delivers uncensored commentary on gender, politics, and power.

feeds.title: Femalista
feeds.description: Women's Rights News is the most prominent Women's Rights page. WRN promotes and advocates an array of topics from global gender equality, feminism, shaming & bullying, body positive & acceptance, rape, rape culture, victim blaming, reproductive rights / pro-choice, women's health, domestic & sexual abuse, survivor & victim stories, SHEroes, human rights, gender pay gap and so much more.

feeds.title: Safe Abortion Women's Right
feeds.description: We are an international network of organisations and individuals in over 115 countries who support SafeAbortion as a woman's right.

feeds.title: Equally Ours » Gender
feeds.description: Equally Ours is a UK charity that brings together people and organizations working across equality, human rights, and social justice. We believe that a good and strong society is a just and inclusive one. One where we are free from harm and can all contribute and flourish, whoever we are, whatever we believe in, and whatever we do and don't have. A society that is equally ours.

feeds.title: Women's Human Rights Education Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Women's Human Rights Institute is an organization that engages in education, advocacy and research to support transnational women's human rights activism

feeds.title: The Fund for Women and Girls
feeds.description: The Fund is dedicated to improving the lives of women and girls and all members of the Chester County community through grantmaking, education and community collaboration.

feeds.title: reneejg.net
feeds.description: This is a blog of writing by Renee Gerlich which is mainly on women's rights, education and the literacy gap, and militarism.

feeds.title: Global Justice Center
feeds.description: The Global Justice Center was founded in 2005 to fill a critical need in the international human rights field. The success of the human rights revolution over the last 30 years has resulted in treaties and international human rights laws that need to move from paper to practice.

feeds.title: Womens Rights Without Frontiers Blog
feeds.description: Women's Rights Without Frontiers is a broad-based, international coalition that opposes forced abortion and sexual slavery in China. Our immediate goal is to raise public awareness regarding the coercive enforcement of China's One Child Policy.
